name: Echo Hub (UK)

radios.note: Amazon UK lists a built-in hub with Zigbee, Thread, Bluetooth and Matter, says Wi-Fi devices sync with it, and says it connects to the internet wirelessly. Ethernet is not recorded because it needs a compatible PoE adapter.

matter.note: Amazon UK says Matter is built in and Amazon's Matter docs list Echo Hub as Matter-enabled. No CSA product listing for Echo Hub was found, so a certificate is not confirmed.

apple_home.note: No official source shows Echo Hub-paired devices in Apple Home.

google_home.note: No official source shows Echo Hub-paired devices in Google Home.

alexa.note: Echo Hub is on Amazon's list of Echo devices with a built-in Zigbee hub, so Zigbee devices pair straight to it and appear in Alexa. Amazon UK also describes Matter and Thread support.

smartthings.note: No official source shows Echo Hub-paired devices in SmartThings.

home_assistant.note: No official Home Assistant page shows Echo Hub-paired devices appearing there.

hubRequired.note: The Echo Hub is the hub. Amazon UK says no separate bridge is needed.

localControl.note: Amazon UK says select devices such as lights, switches and plugs still work when the internet is down.

hubType.note: An 8-inch touch-screen smart home control panel; Amazon UK lists it at £169.99.

deviceProtocols.note: Zigbee devices pair to the built-in hub; Thread serves Matter-over-Thread devices.

matterBridge.note: Amazon's Matter docs describe Echo as the Matter administrator for Alexa, not as a bridge that exposes its devices to other Matter controllers.

threadBorderRouter.note: Listed among Echo and eero devices with a built-in Thread border router, Thread version 1.3.

maxDevices.note: No device limit found in Amazon's sources.

summary: Echo Hub is Amazon's wall-mount control panel for UK homes, with a Zigbee hub and a Thread 1.3 border router built in, so Zigbee devices pair to it with no extra bridge and show up in Alexa. Amazon UK says select lights, switches and plugs keep working when the internet is down. For Apple Home, Google Home, SmartThings and Home Assistant, no official source confirms that paired devices appear there.
caveats: Matter support rests on Amazon's own pages; no CSA listing for Echo Hub was found.
The Echo Hub connects to the internet over Wi-Fi; Ethernet needs a compatible PoE adapter.
No official page shows devices paired to it appearing in Apple Home, Google Home, SmartThings or Home Assistant.
